quotes.text: The return for people who start fast and are now being asked what they'll stay for.
Aries is the sign of starting things, acting on your own and going first. Saturn there asks for the slower version of that: leadership that holds up over time.
quotes.source: launch-kit-v2 (c) bonus style 6: the Aries sign page's about line, as the kit shortens it

quotes.text: Three passes. Not a day. Not a birthday.
quotes.footer: Your Saturn return is a season, with dates

quotes.text: The first one was about what you had to prove. This one's about what outlasts you.
The return for people who built something safe and now have to ask whether it's still good.
Saturn stops on 11 December at 7.9° Aries. If yours is within a degree, this is your closest turn.
Taurus is the sign of what lasts: money, land, the body, routine. Saturn there asks whether your security is real or just familiar.
quotes.source: calendar week 3 (Sat 7 Nov): the Taurus sign page's about line, shortened like the Aries one in (c) bonus style 6

quotes.text: Jennifer Aniston and Kylie Jenner are in the same Saturn return. One week apart.
quotes.source: launch-kit-v2 (c) script 9 hook, as a no-person stand-in for the style 5 piece; dates from (h), checked by check-cohorts.ts

quotes.text: Daniel Craig and Simone Biles are in the same Saturn loop. His second return, her first.
quotes.footer: Three passes each · Saturn turns 11 Dec 2026
quotes.source: calendar week 4 (Tue 10 Nov), no-person stand-in for the style 5 piece. The kit's "both have December passes" is wrong for Craig (20 May 2026, 5 Oct 2026, 11 Feb 2027); the card says what holds: both three-pass, the 11 Dec 2026 station inside both runs
